name: Save Our Seas Foundation Keystone Grants
summary: Biennial grants for established researchers and conservation practitioners running research, conservation and education projects on sharks, rays, skates and chimaeras, with annual renewal for up to three years.
reporting: Grantees submit a final report on the SOSF template, with a financial summary of how the funds were used, no later than 90 days after the project ends.

eligibility.rule: The project concerns marine chondrichthyan species.
The project leader has no ongoing SOSF Keystone Grant.
The project lasts no more than 36 months
Budget asks for no salaries, conference attendance or publication costs

documents: Recent CV for the Project Leader (and co-PL if relevant)
Letter of recommendation (from supervisor, if applicable)

deadline.quote: Deadline for application was May 13th, 2026, 18:00 Central European Time (UTC+1).

status.quote: Applications for the Keystone Grant are CLOSED and will open again mid-March 2028.

administered_by.quote: About the foundation In the effort to protect our oceans, the Save Our Seas Foundation funds and supports research, conservation and education projects worldwide

applicant_types.quote: This fund prioritize projects led by established researchers and conservation practitioners with a demonstrated track record in their field.

geography.quote: The Save Our Seas Foundation (SOSF) is committed to protecting our oceans by funding and supporting research, conservation and education projects worldwide, focusing primarily on threatened marine wildlife and their habitats.

access.quote: The Keystone Grant application process consists of a two-stage online application

window.quote: The funding cycle is biennial, with the grant application window opening in even years (2024, 2026, 2028, etc.)

co_finance_required.quote: Joint funding/co-funding of a project by SOSF with another funding agency is welcomed, but not essential.

reporting.quote: Upon completion of the project, a final report must be submitted using the SOSF template. The report must include a financial summary accounting for the use of the funds provided and be consistent with SOSF's reporting expectations. The report must be submitted no later than 90 days after the project end date.

effort.quote: The Keystone Grant application process consists of a two-stage online application
Stage II, by invitation only based on the Stage I application, will involve the completion of a longer and more detailed online form, equivalent to 10-12 pages.

eligibility.quote: Only projects concerned with marine chondrichthyan species (sharks, rays, skates, sawfishes and chimaeras) will be considered.
If a project leader has an ongoing SOSF Keystone Grant, they can't apply for a new grant.
Costs for salaries, conference attendance and publications are not accepted.

after_award.quote: One blog per semester, of good-quality "web blogs" which will be posted to the SOSF website on the specific Project page and/or on SOSF social media networks.
The Project Leader shall, given reasonable advance notice, permit SOSF access to the Project so that SOSF may have the opportunity of assessing the progress of the Project

documents.quote: Recent CV for the Project Leader (and co-PL if relevant) (required)

A letter of recommendation (with the header or the person's institution), from supervisor if appropriate, otherwise from another person from the institution, or if not someone who can vouch for you and the quality of your work.
